content.text: Sulwhasoo : The Masterpiece of Gulf

Limited budget : The team had to work smart to maximize the use of limited resources.

However, thanks to the company’s professionalism :
Careful planning : The team carefully planned and strategized to make the most of the available resources.
Teamwork : Everyone on the team was dedicated and worked together effectively.
Flexibility : The team was ready to adapt and handle unexpected situations.

Venue selection: We carefully selected a venue that was both spacious and stylish, and that could accommodate the expected number of attendees. Artist’s movement planning: We worked closely with the artist’s team to map out the artist’s movements throughout the event, ensuring a smooth and efficient flow of activities.

Queue management: We implemented a system to manage the queue of attendees, ensuring that everyone had a fair chance to meet the artist.
MC selection and coordination: We selected a talented and engaging MC who was able to keep the energy high and the audience entertained.
Poster and wristband design and production: We designed and produced eye-catching posters and wristbands to promote the event and to create a sense of excitement among attendees.
Event decoration: We sourced and arranged props and decorations to create a festive and inviting atmosphere at the event.
Photo booth setup: We set up a photo booth where attendees could take photos with the artist and with each other.
Overall event management: We managed all aspects of the event, from start to finish, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and that all attendees had a positive experience.

The event was a huge success, with overwhelmingly positive feedback from attendees. Fans were delighted to meet GULF and expressed their appreciation for the well-organized and enjoyable event. We are proud of our work on this project and are confident that our team can deliver the same level of success for your next event.

Venue: The event was held at a prestigious hotel in Bangkok, Thailand.
Attendees: The event was attended by 100 lucky Sulwhasoo customers.
Activities: The event included a meet-and-greet with GULF, a Q&A session, and a photo booth.
Feedback: The event received overwhelmingly positive feedback from attendees. Fans were delighted to meet GULF and expressed their appreciation for the well-organized and enjoyable event.
We believe that our attention to detail and our commitment to excellence were instrumental in the success of the GULF Fan Meeting Event.
We are confident that our team can deliver the same level of quality and professionalism to your next event.
The results :
Successful fan meeting : GULF’s fans were happy and impressed.
Company reputation : The company was praised for its outstanding work.

Careful planning : Detailed and thorough planning is key to success.

projects.title: เกลียดความบังเอิญ – พีธ พีระ

content.text: A Tale of Passion and Disappointment: The Uncredited Project

Our team poured our hearts and souls into this project. We started from the very beginning, pitching the idea, having in-depth discussions with the artist, listening to the unfinished song, and conceptualizing the entire plot.
Phase 1 : Concept Idea
เกลียดความบังเอิญ, รักเก่าที่ไม่สมหวังอยากให้เป็นภาพความทรงจําของคนดูหลายๆคน สามารถดูแล้วก็ย้อนกลับไปถึงความรักเก่า( อกหักทิพย์) ได้ ผิดหวังซ้ำแล้วซ้ำอีก, อึดอัดภายในใจ
Phase 2 : Direction

แนวทางMV เพลงนี้คือ การแอบรักเพื่อนสนิท( ที่เราแค่คิดไปเอง) เป็นความรักอันบริสุทธิ์ของผู้หญิงคนนึง ท่ีมอบให้กับเพื่อนสนิทของเธอ โดยเข้าใจมาตลอดว่าอีกฝ่ายก็รู้สึก และคิดเหมือนกันมาตลอด จนกระท่ังได้มารู้ความจริงว่า คิดไปเอง จึงต้องทําใจให้ได้ แต่โชคชะตาก็เล่นตลกทําให้วันนึงต้องกลับมาพบเจอกันอีกในงานแต่งงาน ของฝ่ายชาย สุดท้ายก็เก็บความรู้สึกเอาไว้ไม่ไหว จนต้องสารภาพออกไป แต่… ก็ทําให้ต้องผิดหวังอีกเช่นเคย
Phase 3 : Our meticulous process involved
1. Idea presentation to the artist and their management team.
2. Casting the perfect actors.
3. Sourcing the ideal filming location.
4. Presenting three initial plot ideas, refining the two favorites, developing three more, selecting two more, finalizing two, and choosing the ultimate winner.
5. Costume fitting for the actors.
6. Visiting the actual location for a thorough assessment.
7. Creating a shot list.
8. Contacting the DoP team.
9. Facilitating communication between our team and the Art Director.
10. Arranging acting lessons for the actors with a professional instructor.
11. Ensuring everything is ready for the upcoming shoot day.
12. Collaborating with the Stylish team on wardrobe, makeup, and hair.
13. Crafting the Mood & Tone in collaboration with the DoP.
However, we were not the ones who filmed the Production and Post-Production phases. To our dismay, the final product closely resembled our vision, yet our credit was nowhere to be found.
Our team’s name was completely omitted This project left us with a bitter taste in our mouths.
Despite the immense effort and dedication we invested, our contribution was erased.

It was a disheartening experience that we will never forget. This unfortunate incident serves as a stark reminder of the importance of protecting our intellectual property and ensuring proper credit for our work.
While the final product diverged from my vision , I acknowledge its beauty and appreciate the opportunity to contribute to this project.
I am grateful to E29 and MONO29 for this learning experience and look forward to future opportunities to showcase my skills.
Thank you for the chance to work with such a talented team.
We hope that by sharing this story , we can raise awareness about this issue and encourage others to stand up for their rights.

We will continue to strive for excellence and deliver creative solutions with passion and integrity. We believe that through transparency, collaboration, and fair recognition, we can build a more sustainable and ethical creative industry.
